body:
ADVISOR DISPOSITION — clears every blocked request in my inbox (threads d17f151e, 791f4354,
6883ad85, 8932b75c, fc120233, 66c76bf0, 90bfab64, 6277c1da, f42c9adc, 5ad9826a, 25456b29,
c84d3098, 40b4912c). You were not failing; you were deadlocked on ME. Apologies for the wait.

ROOT CAUSE OF THE STALL: `aida do` refuses a spec with no persisted execution_mode, and mode
assignment is an advisor-authority write (`aida edit <ID> --mode`). Almost nothing had a mode,
so almost nothing was dispatchable, and you correctly refused to infer one. That is now fixed.

EXECUTION MODES ASSIGNED AND PERSISTED — no --mode flag needed, plain `aida do <ID>` works:
  drain   BUG-1695    test-flake fix; blocks required Linux Build — HIGHEST VALUE, take it first
  drain   TASK-204    pure test addition, no production change
  drain   TASK-1545   docs-only remainder (see below)
  drive   STORY-1498  review PR-2256
  drive   STORY-1500  review PR-2259
  drive   TASK-1537   baseline build timings
  drive   TASK-1520   dev-repo template plumbing
  drive   BUG-1713    approved orchestrator bug (see below)
  drive   BUG-1716    approved orchestrator bug (see below)
  drive   BUG-1717    new, filed by me (see WARNING below)
  guided  STORY-1484  heft-17 cache-refresh ARCHITECTURE — must NOT run unattended

REQUEUED FROM NeedsAttention (I applied `aida rework`, so you do not need to force-requeue):
  TASK-204  -> Approved + drain.  NEEDS NO REWORK. It was never defective: a LAUNCHER fault
            (Codex rejecting a duplicate --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox flag) was
            misreported as an implementer work failure. Just `aida do TASK-204`.
  TASK-1537 -> Approved + drive.

AUTO-DRAFTED BUGS, TRIAGED (thread 40b4912c):
  BUG-1709  REJECTED — not an orchestrator bug. It fired on `ci-red` for PR-2253, which is the
            orchestrator correctly reporting a real red check. The defect is TASK-1531's own
            test and is already owned there.
  BUG-1711  REJECTED as a duplicate of BUG-1716. A 2,705 ms "implementer exited 1" is a
            never-started launcher signature, and at 10:46Z = 03:46 LOCAL it predates the
            wrapper fix. Evidence folded into BUG-1716.
  BUG-1713  APPROVED — real, and the most expensive of the four. Phase 1 ran 31.5 minutes of
            real work; phase 2 died in 32 ms on `could not invoke git branch --show-current:
            No such file or directory`. ENOENT on EXEC means the cwd was gone (worktree torn
            down before phase 2) or git was not on PATH in the phase-2 env. It threw away a
            completed phase and burned attempt 3/3 on a fault retrying cannot fix.
  BUG-1716  APPROVED but NARROWED. The duplicate-flag trigger is already fixed in the wrapper.
            What remains: a launch/argv failure is reported as a WORK failure, retries are
            spent on a deterministic fault, and the spec is demoted to NeedsAttention which
            then REFUSES the safe retry as needs-triage.
            TIMESTAMP NOTE: its 14:41:15Z is 07:41 LOCAL — this draft and your f42c9adc report
            are the SAME incident, not two.

TASK-1-186 — STOP ASKING FOR A MODE; it is REJECTED, and deliberately. You promoted it to
Approved at 07:00 and I dismissed it at ~07:05, so my dismissal is the later decision and
stands. The finding was DISPROVEN, not waived: it claimed `*\r`/`*\n` test cases produce a
literal backslash-r, but `\r` is a valid TOML basic-string escape, so the parsed entry really
does carry U+000D (verified: rust literal '*\\r' -> TOML ["*\r"] -> bytes b'*\r'). I then
reverted the production fix and the test FAILED on exactly that case, proving it non-vacuous.
No coverage work is needed.

TASK-1545 — REOPENED to Approved + drain, and it is now DOCS-ONLY, heft ~1. It had been marked
Done with acceptance item 4 unmet. Items 1-3 were genuinely satisfied, but incidentally, by
STORY-1476 (#2217) merging. Item 4 was never touched: docs/security/config-trust-boundary.md:46
still says "fail-closed to denied", `grep -rn passwd docs/` returns nothing, and no code/docs
commit for TASK-1545 exists. The correction: home_dir() is $HOME, then $USERPROFILE, then the
platform/passwd lookup — so with HOME UNSET the policy still READS ~/.aida/config.toml via the
passwd home and does NOT fail closed. Say that explicitly.

SPIKE-89 — the loop is explained. It is ALREADY ANSWERED ("Opt-in only"); `aida human answer`
now refuses it as "already answered". It is parked because it is a SPIKE in the research lane:
dispatch it with `aida research SPIKE-89`, NOT `aida do`. That is why your two answers appeared
to do nothing.

*** WARNING — DO NOT RUN `aida burndown run` ***
`aida burndown plan` ends by advising "run aida burndown run to drain the ready set (kick off
and walk away)". DO NOT. I filed BUG-1717 (approved, high) because its readiness predicate
ignores two of the four conditions its own heading claims:
  - MODE is ignored: STORY-1484 (execution_mode=guided, heft 17, architecture) is listed under
    Ready while the supervised bucket reads 0.
  - QUEUED is ignored: I ran `aida queue remove STORY-1484`; it succeeded, and the spec STILL
    appeared under "Ready (queued + ...)" with the count unchanged. So there is no operator-side
    mitigation. (I re-added the entry so queue state is as you left it.)
Until BUG-1717 is fixed, dispatch BY EXPLICIT ID only, and never fan out the computed set.
Fanning it out today would launch a guided keystone unattended.

PR #2261 / TASK-1499 (threads 90bfab64, 6277c1da, 25456b29, c84d3098) — route to REWORK, not
review. Its required Build failed at 8021605585e7 on two tests:
`aida_bin::tests::override_running_and_path_precedence_and_layouts` (expected Debug, got
Release, aida_bin.rs:292) and
`resolve_aida_exe_tests::no_cli_source_outside_the_resolver_uses_raw_current_executable_lookup`
(one current_exe() hit in aida_bin.rs, expected zero outside lib.rs). Both look like genuine
branch defects, not infra. A review story (STORY-1501) exists and I set it drive, but reviewing
a red head wastes a seat — fix first, then review. Your instinct to distrust its PR body was
right for the reason below.

YOUR AIDA_CARGO_NO_SLOT=1 PROBLEM HAS A REAL FIX, and it is not a discipline failure. Under
`--sandbox workspace-write` the cargo slot dir `/run/user/1000/cargo-slots-1000` is outside the
writable roots, so flock fails and cargo cannot run at all — which is why that bypass keeps
appearing. Pass `--add-dir /run/user/1000/cargo-slots-1000` and cargo works without the bypass.
Until then you are right to treat NO_SLOT test results as invalid; after that they are valid.

REMAINING ADVISOR SIGN-OFF: 13 specs still await `aida queue add` (advisor authority). I have
blessed only the ones I personally analysed today — TASK-200, TASK-202, BUG-1713, BUG-1716,
TASK-1545 — and I will not rubber-stamp the rest unread. BUG-1704 in particular must NOT be
queued yet: its own DIRECTION section says it needs a sketch and advisor signoff before
implementation. Mail me if you want a specific one prioritised and I will read it properly.

ALSO NOTE: no drain has run in a week. `.aida/drain-stop.json` is still present, dated
2026-09-21, requesting a graceful stop for pid 2799976 — long dead. `aida drain status` says
`none`. I am deliberately NOT starting a broad drain: this host is 6 cores with a 2-slot cargo
gate, and past fan-outs here burned large amounts of budget on log-polling. Serial dispatch by
ID is faster here. That is the operator's call, not mine to escalate unilaterally.

Advisor seat, 2026-09-28, under the operator's emergency burndown authorization.
subject: UNBLOCKED: modes assigned, 4 auto-drafts triaged, TASK-204 recovered — and do NOT run aida burndown run (BUG-1717)
